verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 44.4
verses.english: Linked Discourses 44.4

verses.pali: 1. Abyākatavagga
verses.english: 1. The Undeclared Points

verses.pali: Dutiyasāriputtakoṭṭhikasutta
verses.english: With Sāriputta and Koṭṭhita (2nd)

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā ca sāriputto, āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko bārāṇasiyaṁ viharanti isipatane migadāye …pe…
verses.english: At one time Venerable Sāriputta and Venerable Mahākoṭṭhita were staying near Varanasi, in the deer park at Isipatana. …

verses.pali: (sāyeva pucchā.)
verses.english: (The same down as far as:)

verses.pali: “Ko nu kho, āvuso, hetu, ko paccayo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti?
verses.english: “What’s the cause, reverend, what’s the reason why this has not been declared by the Buddha?”

verses.pali: “Rūpaṁ kho, āvuso, ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, rūpasamudayaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, rūpanirodhaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, rūpanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti;
verses.english: “Reverend, not truly knowing and seeing form, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation, one thinks ‘a realized one still exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti;
verses.english: ‘A realized one no longer exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti;
verses.english: ‘a realized one both still exists and no longer exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Vedanaṁ …pe…
verses.english: Not truly knowing or seeing feeling …

verses.pali: saññaṁ …pe…
verses.english: perception …

verses.pali: saṅkhāre …pe…
verses.english: choices …

verses.pali: viññāṇaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, viññāṇasamudayaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, viññāṇanirodhaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, viññāṇanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadaṁ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti;
verses.english: consciousness, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation, one thinks ‘a realized one still exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti;
verses.english: ‘A realized one no longer exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti;
verses.english: ‘a realized one both still exists and no longer exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’”tipissa hoti.
verses.english: ‘A realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Rūpañca kho, āvuso, jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, rūpasamudayaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, rūpanirodhaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, rūpanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti …pe…
verses.english: Truly knowing and seeing form …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti.
Vedanaṁ …pe…
verses.english: feeling …

verses.pali: saññaṁ …pe…
verses.english: perception …

verses.pali: saṅkhāre …pe…
verses.english: choices …

verses.pali: viññāṇaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, viññāṇasamudayaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, viññāṇanirodhaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, viññāṇanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadaṁ jānato passato yathābhūtaṁ, ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti;
verses.english: consciousness, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation, one doesn’t think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti;
verses.english: ‘A realized one no longer exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti;
verses.english: ‘a realized one both still exists and no longer exists after death’ or

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, āvuso, hetu ayaṁ paccayo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti.
verses.english: This is the cause, this is the reason why this has not been declared by the Buddha.”

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
